section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1983
title: 10 ## Union Territories The incidence of accidental deaths came down to 9·2 per cent in 1983 over 1982 in the Union Territories as a whole. The Union Territories, which registered a decline in the total number of accidental deaths in 1983 over 1982 were Lakshadweep (33·3%), A & N Islands (10·0%), Chandigarh (6·4%) and Delhi (5·8%). Rest of the U.Ts. registered an increase in total number of accidental deaths over 1982.
